q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a paper plate?
title: Paper plate carbon footprint per piece
short: Multiply the paperboard per plate, including trim waste, by the board mill's per-kg figure. Add press heating and electricity, then divide the unit's energy by plates packed and report by diameter and board GSM.
audience: Paper plate and disposable tableware makers

ul: Paperboard by weight per plate, laminated or not.

p: Report per plate with diameter and GSM. Board is most of the total, so the mill's figure matters most.

example.title: Worked example: paper plate unit per piece (one month)
lines: Plant total: 4,260 / 2,000,000 = 0.00213 kg CO2 per piece
Add paperboard and lamination for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
